props.name: className
props.description: The skeleton's size and radius, such as `h-4 w-48` or `size-10 rounded-full`. The pulse and the muted fill are the skeleton's own. The skeleton is hidden from screen readers, so mark the region that is loading with `aria-busy`.

props.name: children
props.description: The content, which the skeleton is drawn from while `loading`. Renders the data, or the stand-in the skeleton is drawn from: the data on screen, the last data shown, or `sample`. While loading, the content renders unseen, and the skeleton draws a bar over each line of its text and a block over each control, avatar, badge or image. The skeleton takes the content's exact space, so the page does not move when the data arrives. When the content is taller or shorter than its skeleton, the root eases to the new height, at once under reduced motion. The skeleton is hidden from screen readers and inert, and the content can take focus once it replaces the skeleton. Form controls in the skeleton are neither submitted nor validated with their form, and Fuse overlays in it, such as a Dialog left open, do not open. Keep any portal of your own in the content closed while it loads. Before the page hydrates, the skeleton strikes a thick bar through each line of text. Mark your own markup with `data-skeleton="block"` to draw it as one block, or with `data-skeleton="ignore"` to leave it and everything inside it out.

props.name: data
props.description: The data to show. The skeleton shows while it is `null` or `undefined`.

props.name: label
props.description: Read to screen readers while loading, in place of the skeleton, such as "Loading invoices". The root is `aria-busy` meanwhile. Defaults to the locale dictionary's "Loading".

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows the skeleton drawn from `children` instead of `children` themselves. Shows the skeleton over `data` too, as for a refetch. It is drawn from the data on screen.

props.name: onReveal
props.description: Called once content has come in over a skeleton and finished arriving. A reveal interrupted by loading again, or by unmounting, does not call it. One that Suspense or a hidden `Activity` interrupted, or that came due while hidden, finishes at once when the reveal shows again and calls it then; one that a later load replaced while hidden does not.

props.name: render
props.description: Allows you to replace the component's HTML element with a different tag, or compose it with another component. Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.

props.name: reveal
props.description: How content replaces the skeleton. `smart`, the default, holds a client skeleton back 150 ms so a fast load never shows one, lands content at once over a skeleton that was up only a moment or while someone scrolls or types, crossfades a refetch and small content, and brings larger content in row by row. `together` crossfades it all at once; `sequence` brings each piece in by its place, top to bottom and then a little left to right.

props.name: sample
props.description: Stands in for `data` to draw the skeleton before any data has loaded.
